default_profiles.description: Clean lines, open spaces, and intentional design. Your dream home is proof that less really is more. Every element earns its place.

default_profiles.graphic_mood: minimal, clean, modern architecture, open spaces with natural light and neutral tones

default_profiles.description: Home is where the heart is, and yours is big. You want a place where memories are made, kids can play, and everyone has room to grow.
default_profiles.share_text: I'm The Nester! Big yard, cozy spaces, and room for everyone. Build your Dream Home Wishlist:

default_profiles.description: Your home is where the party happens. An open kitchen for cooking with friends, outdoor space for gatherings, and every detail designed for hosting.
default_profiles.share_text: I'm The Entertainer! Gourmet kitchen, pool, outdoor living. My home is the gathering place. Build your Dream Home Wishlist:
default_profiles.graphic_mood: inviting, social, open-concept kitchen flowing to outdoor entertaining area with pool

default_profiles.description: You want to be where the action is. Walkable streets, great restaurants, cultural experiences. Your home is your launchpad to city life.
default_profiles.share_text: I'm The Urbanite! Walkable streets, city vibes, culture on my doorstep. Build your Dream Home Wishlist:
default_profiles.graphic_mood: urban, energetic, city views from stylish loft or condo, vibrant neighborhood

default_profiles.description: Peace, quiet, and a view that never gets old. Your dream home is a sanctuary. Water, trees, or open sky. Room to breathe.
default_profiles.share_text: I'm The Retreater! Waterfront views, wide open spaces, total tranquility. Build your Dream Home Wishlist:
default_profiles.graphic_mood: serene, waterfront or rural, panoramic nature views, peaceful private setting
